title: I Love the Computer
summary: A personal essay expressing the author's passion and deep appreciation for computers and programming, reflecting on the joy and fulfillment derived from working with technology.
problem_solved: Explores the emotional and philosophical aspects of why developers love their craft, resonating with those who share similar passions.
why_valuable: Provides authentic, relatable insights into the personal joy of computing, fostering community connection among tech enthusiasts who may feel the same way about their work.
